title: Respiratory rate
text: Count breaths for 30 seconds while the person rests and is not speaking, then double the count. Do not tell them you are counting, or the rate changes.
21 to 24 breaths per minute scores watch; 25 or above, or 8 or below, scores critical under NEWS2. Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

citations.source: NEWS2 (Royal College of Physicians, 2017): single-parameter scores for respiratory rate.
